title: Amazon SQS message quotas
note: Lesson 2.1 fix (AWS-L21-002 and TEACHER-L21-002, K11): fetched from docs.aws.amazon.com and checked against the FIFO throughput quotas (300 TPS per API action unbatched, 3,000 TPS batched, and a Region-dependent higher quota in high-throughput mode) and the message retention (4 days default, 14 days maximum), message size (up to 1,048,576 bytes / 1 MiB), and visibility timeout (30 seconds default, 12 hours maximum) figures.
